tweets.text: We are living in a simulation. It's just a simulation we build for each other. When you figure out that we're all God together, that tends to change your religious beliefs. My first TV camera cost $130,000. It was purchased by a church, and I ran it in the middle of a thousand people every Sunday. That took me on a path of studying faith in the world. I have no problem with any of it anymore. Believe what you want; a few of us continue to search for the truth. The AI people call it ground truth.

tweets.text: My clients sometimes have products that suck, but at one point, FSD sucked too. It always gets better, even if the government tries to hold it back. But it might take an extra week. Or two. Or more.
